docker-compose.yml:
# Web app + database. The hosting worker runs separately (see README) because it controls Docker.
services:
  db:
    image: postgres:16
    environment: { POSTGRES_USER: codex, POSTGRES_PASSWORD: "${DB_PASSWORD}", POSTGRES_DB: codex }
    volumes: [pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data]
    restart: unless-stopped
  web:
    build: .
    env_file: .env
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://codex:${DB_PASSWORD}@db:5432/codex
      DATA_DIR: /data
      WORKER_URL: ${WORKER_URL:-http://host.docker.internal:4000}
    extra_hosts: ["host.docker.internal:host-gateway"]
    ports: ["3000:3000"]
    volumes: [webdata:/data]
    depends_on: [db]
    restart: unless-stopped
volumes:
  pgdata:
  webdata:
Dockerfile:
FROM node:20-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json ./
RUN npm install --no-audit --no-fund
COPY . .
RUN npm run build
ENV NODE_ENV=production
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["sh", "-c", "npm run db:init && npm start"]
